tuition_model.notes: Official ISEG / ULisboa incoming mobility page confirms bilateral/Erasmus exchange students pay zero tuition fees to ISEG (Free-Movers pay EUR 60 application fee + course fees).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: ISEG 'Living in Lisbon' publishes EUR 600–700/month accommodation + EUR 200–250/month meals (= EUR 800–950/month before public transit and personal costs).

housing_availability.notes: Fact Sheet states: 'There is no on-campus accommodation at ISEG, but students may find private accommodation'; private student residences/platforms suggested.

housing_notes.value: No ISEG on-campus housing; shared rooms/private residences near campus (Santos/Cais do Sodre/Quelhas) EUR 600–700/month.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA students must obtain a Type D Student Visa before arrival (tourist visas cannot be converted) with passport (>=3 mos post-stay), ISEG Acceptance Letter, proof of subsistence/accommodation, criminal record, medical/health insurance.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS; normal workload 30 ECTS per semester.
